part2.audioText: Why is the parking garage closed today?
part2.explanation: Why 問原因，(B)「他們在重畫停車格線」正確。(A) 回答地點，(C) 回答數量。

part2.audioText: Which caterer did we use for last year's banquet?
part2.explanation: Which caterer 問哪一家外燴業者，(C) 直接回答業者名稱 Golden Fork，正確。(A) 只評論食物沒回答是哪家。

part2.audioText: Do you want me to book a window or an aisle seat?
part2.explanation: A or B 選擇疑問句，(A)「靠走道座位」選了其中一個，正確。(B) 選擇疑問句不能只回 Yes。

part2.audioText: How long will the software update take?
part2.explanation: How long 問時間長度，(B)「不超過二十分鐘」正確。(A) 回答版本，(C) 回答範圍。

part2.audioText: The quarterly figures look better than expected, don't they?
optionAudioTexts: Yes, sales were up in every region.
part2.explanation: 附加問句尋求同意（數字比預期好吧？），(A)「是啊，每個地區銷售都成長」正確。(B) 用 quarter 諧音混淆。

part2.audioText: Who should I contact about a lost ID badge?
optionAudioTexts: In the lost and found box.
part2.explanation: Who 問該找誰，(C)「警衛室負責處理」正確。(B) 回答地點而非人員。

part2.audioText: Where's the nearest ATM around here?
optionAudioTexts: There's one in the convenience store across the street.
part2.explanation: Where 問地點，(A)「對面便利商店裡有一台」正確。(C) 只說自己也需要現金，沒有回答位置。

part2.audioText: Would you like me to save you a seat at the seminar?
part2.explanation: Would you like me to...? 是好意提議，(A)「那太好了，謝謝」接受提議，正確。

script: W: Hi Daniel, do you have a minute? I'd like your opinion on the cover design for the annual report.
M: Sure. Hmm, I like the photo, but the title is a little hard to read against the dark background.
W: I thought so too. What if I change the font color to white and make it slightly larger?
M: That would help a lot. Also, shouldn't the company's new slogan be on the cover? The president specifically asked for that.
W: Oh, you're right. I completely forgot. I'll add it under the title.
M: Great. Once you've made the changes, send it to me and I'll show it to the president this afternoon.

questions.q: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
questions.explanation: 女子請男子看年報封面設計並討論修改，故選 (A)。

questions.q: What problem does the man point out?
options: The title is hard to read.
questions.explanation: 男子說 the title is a little hard to read against the dark background（標題在深色背景上不易閱讀），故選 (B)。

questions.q: What did the woman forget to include?
questions.explanation: 男子提醒總裁特別要求放新標語，女子說 I completely forgot（完全忘了），故選 (A)。

script: M: Claire, I just got an e-mail from the Hillside Community Center. They want us to give a nutrition workshop for seniors next month.
W: That sounds like a great opportunity. How many people are they expecting?
M: Around forty. They asked if we could do it on either the tenth or the seventeenth, both Saturdays.
W: I'm attending a conference on the tenth, so the seventeenth works better for me.
M: The seventeenth it is. They also asked whether we need any equipment.
W: Just a microphone and a screen for slides. Oh, and let's prepare some printed recipes to hand out. People always love those.

questions.q: What has the community center asked the speakers to do?
questions.explanation: 男子說社區中心希望他們 give a nutrition workshop for seniors（為長者舉辦營養講座），故選 (B)。

questions.q: Why does the woman prefer the seventeenth?
options: She will be at a conference on the tenth.
The room is bigger that day.
The center is closed on the tenth.
questions.explanation: 女子說 I'm attending a conference on the tenth（10 號要參加研討會），所以 17 號比較好，故選 (A)。

questions.q: What does the woman suggest preparing?
questions.explanation: 女子說 let's prepare some printed recipes to hand out（準備印好的食譜發給大家），故選 (C)。

part4.script: Good morning, everyone. Before we open the store, I have a few quick announcements. First, our summer clearance sale starts today, so expect larger crowds than usual, especially in the electronics section. Extra staff will be working at the registers, but if lines get long, please open register five. Second, the elevator near the food court is out of service. A repair team is scheduled to arrive at ten, and the work should take about two hours. Please direct customers to the escalators on the east side in the meantime. Finally, don't forget that the new employee recognition program starts this month. Every week, one team member will be chosen for outstanding customer service and will receive a fifty-dollar gift card. Have a great day, everyone.

questions.q: Where most likely are the listeners?
questions.explanation: 提到 open the store、clearance sale、registers（收銀台）、electronics section，可知是百貨/賣場員工晨會，故選 (B)。

questions.q: What problem does the speaker mention?
options: An elevator is out of service.
questions.explanation: the elevator near the food court is out of service，美食街旁的電梯故障，故選 (B)。

questions.q: According to the speaker, what can employees receive for outstanding service?
questions.explanation: will receive a fifty-dollar gift card，表現優異者每週選出一位可獲 50 元禮物卡，故選 (C)。

part4.script: Hi, this is Monica Reyes from Skyline Travel, returning your call about your trip to Vancouver in September. I checked the flights you asked about, and I have some good news. If you're able to leave on Tuesday, September eighth, instead of Monday the seventh, the round-trip fare drops by almost two hundred dollars per person. The hotel you wanted, the Bayview Inn, still has rooms available for those dates, and they're offering a free breakfast package this fall. I went ahead and placed a twenty-four-hour hold on both the flights and the hotel, but I'll need your confirmation by five P.M. tomorrow to lock in these prices. Please call me back at 555-0192, extension 34. Thanks, and talk to you soon.

questions.explanation: 旅行社人員回電說明航班與飯店查詢結果，提供旅遊資訊，故選 (B)。

questions.q: What does the speaker say about leaving on September eighth?
questions.explanation: 改為 9/8 出發，來回機票每人便宜近兩百元（the fare drops by almost two hundred dollars），故選 (A)。

questions.q: What is the listener asked to do by tomorrow at 5 P.M.?
questions.explanation: I'll need your confirmation by five P.M. tomorrow，明天下午五點前需回覆確認，故選 (B)。

part5.q: The finance department will distribute the updated expense forms ------- the end of the week.
part5.explanation: by + 時間 = 在…之前完成。「財務部將在週末前發放新版費用表單」。

part5.q: Applicants should describe their previous work experience as ------- as possible.
part5.explanation: as ... as possible 中間修飾動詞 describe，要用副詞 specifically（具體地）。「申請者應盡可能具體描述過去的工作經驗」。

part5.q: Neither of the two conference rooms ------- available on Thursday afternoon.
part5.explanation: Neither of + 複數名詞，動詞用單數 is。「兩間會議室週四下午都沒空」。

part5.q: The company picnic will be held outdoors, weather -------.
part5.explanation: weather permitting = 天氣許可的話（獨立分詞構句，固定用法）。

part5.q: Sales of the new smartphone have grown ------- since its release in June.
part5.explanation: 修飾動詞 have grown 用副詞 steadily（穩定地）。「新手機自六月上市以來銷量穩定成長」。

part5.q: Please note that the discount coupon is valid for online purchases -------.
part5.explanation: valid for online purchases only = 僅限線上購物使用。only 放句尾強調限制。

part5.q: Mr. Tanaka postponed his business trip ------- he could attend the shareholders' meeting.
part5.explanation: so that + 子句 = 以便…。「田中先生延後出差以便出席股東會」。in order to 後接原形動詞。

part5.q: The hotel's rooftop restaurant offers ------- views of the harbor.
part5.explanation: 修飾名詞 views 用形容詞 impressive（令人驚豔的）。「頂樓餐廳可欣賞壯麗的港景」。

part5.q: All returns must be accompanied ------- the original receipt.
part5.explanation: be accompanied by = 附上/伴隨…。「退貨須附原始收據」。

part5.q: ------- the merger is finalized, the two companies will operate under a single brand name.
part5.explanation: Once + 子句 = 一旦…。「合併一旦完成，兩家公司將以單一品牌營運」。

part5.q: The training manual explains the safety procedures in ------- detail.
part5.explanation: considerable detail = 相當詳細。considerate 是「體貼的」，容易混淆。

part5.q: Ms. Chen asked that the invoice ------- to the accounting department by noon.
part5.explanation: ask that + 主詞 + (should) + 原形動詞（假設語氣），故用 be sent。「陳小姐要求發票中午前送至會計部」。

part6.passage:
【Press Release】
Aurora Coffee Opens Flagship Store Downtown

Aurora Coffee announced that its new flagship store will open on Saturday, August 15, at 210 Main Street. The two-story café will be the company's [33] location in the city, joining five existing branches. To celebrate the opening, the first 100 customers will receive a free drink of their [34]. The flagship store will also feature a roasting room where visitors can watch beans being roasted on-site. "We wanted to create a space where customers can experience coffee from bean to cup," said founder Elena Vasquez. The store will be open daily from 7:00 A.M. to 9:00 P.M. [35] information is available at www.auroracoffee.com.

questions.explanation: joining five existing branches（加入既有五間分店），新店是第六間，選 sixth。
of their choice = 自選的，固定用法。「前 100 名顧客可獲自選免費飲品」。
修飾名詞 information 用形容詞 Additional（更多的）。Additional information is available at... 為常見句型。

part6.passage:
To: Customer Service Team
From: IT Department
Subject: New Ticketing System

Starting Monday, our department will [36] a new online ticketing system for handling technical support requests. All requests must be submitted through the new system; e-mailed requests will no longer be [37]. To submit a ticket, log in to the staff portal and click "IT Support." You will receive an automatic reply with a ticket number, [38] you can use to track the status of your request. A short training video is available on the portal. Please watch it before Monday.

questions.explanation: launch a new system = 啟用新系統。後文都在說明新系統如何使用，故選 launch。
所有需求「必須」透過新系統提交，電子郵件申請「將不再被接受」，選 accepted。
關係代名詞 which 指前面的 a ticket number，「你可以用它來追蹤處理進度」。

part7.passage:
【Web page】
www.metrobiz.com/workshops

MetroBiz Small Business Workshops — August Schedule

All workshops are held at the MetroBiz Learning Center, 44 Union Street, from 6:30 P.M. to 8:30 P.M. Fee: $25 per workshop, or $80 for all four. Advance registration is required, as seating is limited to 30 participants per session.

• Aug 6 (Thu) — Social Media Marketing on a Budget: Learn low-cost strategies to reach new customers online.
• Aug 13 (Thu) — Basic Bookkeeping for Owners: Understand invoices, expenses, and simple monthly reports.
• Aug 20 (Thu) — Hiring Your First Employee: Covers job postings, interviews, and required paperwork.
• Aug 27 (Thu) — Winning Government Contracts: How small firms can bid for city and county projects.

Participants who attend all four workshops will receive a certificate of completion and a free 30-minute consultation with a MetroBiz advisor.

questions.q: For whom are the workshops most likely intended?
questions.explanation: 系列名稱是 Small Business Workshops，主題（記帳、僱用第一位員工等）都針對小型企業主，故選 (B)。

questions.q: How much does it cost to attend all four workshops?
questions.explanation: $25 per workshop, or $80 for all four，四場合購 80 元，故選 (C)。
8/20「Hiring Your First Employee」內容包含 job postings, interviews, and required paperwork，故選 (C)。

questions.q: What will participants who attend all four sessions receive?
options: A discount on next year's workshops
questions.explanation: 全勤者可獲結業證書與 free 30-minute consultation（免費 30 分鐘諮詢），故選 (B)。

part7.passage:
【E-mail】
From: Support <support@cloudledger.com>
To: Amy Hsu <ahsu@brightlane.com>
Subject: Your subscription renewal
Date: August 4

Dear Ms. Hsu,

This is a reminder that your CloudLedger Pro subscription will expire on August 18. To avoid any interruption to your accounting services, please renew before that date.

We would also like to inform you of a change to our pricing. Beginning September 1, the monthly Pro plan will increase from $24 to $27 per month. However, customers who renew with an annual plan before August 18 will keep the current rate of $240 per year — a savings of $84 compared with the new monthly pricing.

As a loyal customer since 2023, you are also eligible for a free upgrade to our new Reports+ feature for the first year of an annual plan. To renew, simply log in to your account and select "Billing."

Thank you for choosing CloudLedger.

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the e-mail?
options: To remind a customer to renew a subscription
questions.explanation: 開頭即說 This is a reminder that your subscription will expire on August 18，提醒續約，故選 (B)。

options: A new feature will be removed.
questions.explanation: Beginning September 1, the monthly Pro plan will increase from $24 to $27，月費將調漲，故選 (A)。

questions.q: What is suggested about Ms. Hsu?
options: She has been a customer for several years.
questions.explanation: As a loyal customer since 2023（自 2023 年以來的老客戶），可知她已是多年用戶，故選 (B)。
